item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Chicken soup, a deep, clear soup with chicken and tender diced potatoes, topped with a generous spoonful of leeks, carrots and celeriac with butter and herbs. Served with pickled pearl onions and crispy cheese and garlic croutons. Also available gluten free. (1+2+6+10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Char siu pork chops, juicy chops marinated in an intense, sticky Cantonese BBQ marinade of hoisin, Chinese five-spice, honey and red rice wine, served with stir-fried wheat noodles with sesame and topped with garlic-fried Chinese cabbage and green beans. Served with Chinese smashed cucumber salad. Also available gluten free with rice noodles. (1+7+8+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Char siu tofu medallions, firm, meaty tofu medallions marinated in an intense, sticky Cantonese BBQ marinade of hoisin, Chinese five-spice, honey and red rice wine, served with stir-fried wheat noodles with sesame and topped with garlic-fried Chinese cabbage and green beans. Served with Chinese smashed cucumber salad. Also available gluten free with rice noodles. (1+7+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Slow-braised pork with root vegetables, fresh herbs and potatoes, seasoned with apples and mustard. (11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Thai fishcakes with the flavours of Thailand, served with a noodle salad with spinach, bean sprouts, carrot and pak choi. Served with sweet chilli. (1+2+3+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Marinated tofu served with a noodle salad with spinach, bean sprouts, carrot and pak choi. Served with sweet chilli. (1+2+3+7+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Roasted chicken yakitori, juicy chicken marinated in a rich, sweet and spicy Japanese soy-mirin glaze and roasted until caramelised, served with jasmine rice and topped with spring onion and sesame seeds. Served with chilli sauce and stir-fried broccoli and white cabbage tossed in dark sesame oil. Gluten free, and also available with wholegrain rice. (7+8+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Roasted Oumph! yakitori, protein-rich plant-based soy pieces marinated in a rich, sweet and spicy Japanese soy-mirin glaze and roasted until caramelised, served with jasmine rice and topped with spring onion and sesame seeds. Served with chilli sauce and stir-fried broccoli and white cabbage tossed in dark sesame oil. Gluten free, and also available with wholegrain rice. (7+8+13+15)
